quotes.quote: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.

quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Wonder is the beginning of wisdom.

quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Authority without wisdom is like a heavy axe without an edge, fitter to bruise than polish.
quotes.author: Anne Bradstreet

quotes.quote: Having children makes you no more a parent than having a piano makes you a pianist.
quotes.author: Michael Levine

quotes.quote: For me, I am driven by two main philosophies: know more today about the world than I knew yesterday and lessen the suffering of others. You'd be surprised how far that gets you.

quotes.quote: Doctor Who: You want weapons? We're in a library. Books are the best weapon in the world. This room's the greatest arsenal we could have. Arm yourself!(from Tooth and Claw in Season 2)
quotes.author: Russell T. Davies

quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: It is one thing to be clever and another to be wise.
quotes.author: George R.R. Martin

quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: The public have an insatiable curiosity to know everything, except what is worth knowing.

quotes.author: Margaret Atwood,  The Blind Assassin

quotes.quote: For me, it is far better to grasp the Universe as it really is than to persist in delusion, however satisfying and reassuring.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

quotes.quote: I ask not for any crownBut that which all may win;Nor try to conquer any worldExcept the one within.

quotes.quote: Knowledge is power. Power to do evil...or power to do good. Power itself is not evil. So knowledge itself is not evil.

quotes.quote: Suffering is a gift. In it is hidden mercy.

quotes.quote: To finish the moment, to find the journey's end in every step of the road, to live the greatest number of good hours, is wisdom.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: It is very hard to be brave,"said Piglet, sniffing slightly, "when you're only a Very Small Animal."Rabbit, who had begun to write very busily, looked up and said: "It is because you are a very small animal that you will be Useful in the adventure before us.
quotes.author: Benjamin Hoff,  The Te of Piglet

quotes.quote: [novan]: bassists are very good with their fingers[novan]: and some of us sing backup vocals, so that means we're good with our mouths too...(~ IM chat with Novan Chang, 18, bassist)
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel

quotes.quote: If one tries to navigate unknown waters one runs the risk of shipwreck

quotes.quote: Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise."(reported by Ibn Majah and others, fulfilling the conditions of Imam al Bukhari and Imam Muslim)

quotes.quote: I used to think I knew what was right and what was wrong, and who the good guys are, and who the bad guys are. Then the world got very gray, and I didn't know anything for a long time
quotes.author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  Incubus Dreams

quotes.quote: Even if you are alone you wage war with yourself.
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sun Watches the Sun

quotes.quote: Wonder is the beginning of wisdom in learning from books as well as from nature.
quotes.author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Bestselling Guide to Reading Books and Accessing Information

quotes.quote: At times anger will trigger harsh words. After a cooling period wisdom sets in; finally, the ability to speak from the heart with love and compassion.
quotes.author: Ana Monnar,  Relax: New And Selected Poems: New And Selected Poems

quotes.quote: Bitter your acts, bitter am I,Kindness your deeds, kindness am I,Pleasant and gentle, so you are,Fine honeyed lips and sweet talker.
quotes.author: Rumi,  Love: The Joy That Wounds: The Love Poems of Rumi

quotes.quote: The whole problem with the world is that fools and fanatics are always so certain of themselves, and wiser people so full of doubts.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: The master of the garden is the one who waters it, trims the branches, plants the seeds, and pulls the weeds. If you merely stroll through the garden, you are but an acolyte.

quotes.quote: Perhaps wisdom is simply a matter of waiting, and healing a question of time. And anything good you've ever been given is yours forever.
quotes.author: Rachel Naomi Remen

quotes.quote: Hell is truth known too late.
quotes.author: J.C. Ryle,  Practical Religion

quotes.quote: Reports that say that something hasn't happened are always interesting to me, because as we know, there are known knowns; there are things we know we know. We also know there are known unknowns; that is to say we know there are some things we do not know. But there are also unknown unknowns- the ones we don't know we don't know.
quotes.author: Donald Rumsfeld

quotes.quote: in times like the present, men should utter nothing for which they would not willingly be responsible through time and eternity.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Someone said, 'The dead writers are remote from us because we know so much more than they did.' Precisely, and they are that which we know.
quotes.author: T.S. Eliot,  Selected Essays

quotes.quote: The soil needs the seed and the seed needs the soil. The one only has meaning with the other. It is the same thing with human beings. quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Brida

quotes.quote: Often the hands will solve a mystery that the intellect has struggled with in vain.
quotes.author: C.G. Jung

quotes.quote: Stuff your brain with knowledge.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: To pursue wisdom is to live in such a way that one is prepared to face death when it comes. (247)
quotes.author: Gregory Bassham,  The Ultimate Harry Potter and Philosophy: Hogwarts for Muggles

quotes.quote: They say that patriotism is the last refuge to which a scoundrel clings steal a little and they throw you in jail. Steal a lot and then they make you king.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: It don't do you no nevermind to tell nobody nothing.
quotes.author: Thomas McGuane

quotes.quote: Misfortunes make us wise
quotes.author: Mary Norton,  The Borrowers Afield

quotes.quote: Never pause unless you have a reason for it, but when you pause, pause as long as you can.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham,  Theatre

quotes.quote: Science, my boy, is made up of mistakes, but they are mistakes which it is useful to make, because they lead little by little to the truth.
quotes.author: Jules Verne,  Journey to the Center of the Earth

quotes.quote: The truth is always something that is told, not something that is known. If there were no speaking or writing, there would be no truth about anything. There would only be what is.
quotes.author: Susan Sontag,  The Benefactor

quotes.quote: I am blind and limited. I would be a fool think myself wise. And so, not knowing what the universe means, I can only try to be responsible with the knowledge, the strength, and the time given to me. I must be true to my heart.
quotes.author: Jim Butcher,  Death Masks

quotes.quote: Experience is more important than knowledge.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

quotes.quote: Quote words that affirmall men and women are yourbrothers and sisters.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

quotes.quote: there is only one way under high heaven to get the best of an argument - and that is to avoid it .

quotes.quote: Intelligence alone is not nearly enough when it comes to acting wisely.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  Crime and Punishment

quotes.quote: You have a great heart, but will only find it to be so through great pain. This is the wisdom of love, and its doubtful gift. . . . I have endured much suffering and still remain unbitter and unclosed.
quotes.author: Alison Croggon,  The Naming

quotes.quote: Friendship, as has been said, consists in a full commitment of the will to another person with a view to that person's good.
quotes.author: Pope John Paul II,  Love and Responsibility

quotes.quote: re-examine all you have been told in school or church or in any book, and dismiss whatever insults your own soul; and your very flesh shall be a great poem, and have the richest fluency, not only in its words, but in the silent lines of its lips and face, and between the lashes of your eyes, and in every motion and joint of your body.[From the preface to Leaves Grass]
quotes.author: Walt Whitman,  Leaves of Grass

quotes.quote: Purity of heart is what enables us to see.
quotes.author: Pope Benedict XVI,  Jesus of Nazareth: From the Baptism in the Jordan to the Transfiguration

quotes.quote: Our wisdom comes from our experience,and our experience comes from our foolishness.
quotes.author: Sacha Guitry

quotes.quote: To believe yourself brave is to be brave; it is the one only essential thing.
quotes.author: Mark Twain,  Joan of Arc

quotes.author: Rumi,  The Essential Rumi

quotes.quote: When I think of talking, it is of course with a woman. For talking at its best being an inspiration, it wants a corresponding divine quality of receptiveness, and where will you find this but in a woman?
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

quotes.quote: We never know the worth of water till the well is dry.
quotes.author: Thomas Fuller

quotes.quote: Burnout is nature's way of telling you, you've been going through the motions your soul has departed; you're a zombie, a member of the walking dead, a sleepwalker. False optimism is like administrating stimulants to an exhausted nervous system.
quotes.author: Sam Keen,  Fire in the Belly: On Being a Man

quotes.quote: Burn worldly love, rub the ashes and make ink of it, make the heart the pen, the intellect the writer, write that which has no end or limit.
quotes.author: Guru Nanak,  Sri Guru Granth Sahib

quotes.quote: Jewels can be replaced, cousin. Independence, once lost, cannot.
quotes.author: R.L. LaFevers,  Dark Triumph

quotes.quote: It would be the height of absurdity to label ignorance tempered by humility "faith"!(Institutio III.2.3)
quotes.author: John Calvin

quotes.author: Tobsha Learner,  The Witch of Cologne

quotes.quote: Don't overact the story of your name. Overact the story of your work.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: And last are the few whose delight is in meditation and understanding; who yearn not for goods, nor for victory, but for knowledge; who leave both market and battlefield to lose themselves in the quiet clarity of secluded thought; whose will is a light rather than a fire, whose haven is not power but truth: these are the men of wisdom, who stand aside unused by the world.
quotes.author: Will Durant,  The Story of Philosophy

quotes.quote: Each person you meetis an aspect of yourself,clamoring for love.
quotes.author: Eric Micha'el Leventhal

quotes.quote: Education is beautification of the inner world and the outer world.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

quotes.quote: The fact that I can plant a seed and it becomes a flower, share a bit of knowledge and it becomes another's, smile at someone and receive a smile in return, are to me continual spiritual exercises.
quotes.author: Leo Buscaglia

quotes.author: Roman Payne

We need to create change for ourselves, in a workable way, as part of our everyday lives.
quotes.author: Sharon Salzberg,  The Power of Meditation: A 28-Day Programme for Real Happiness

quotes.quote: The one who would be constant in happiness must frequently change.
quotes.author: Anthony de Mello,  Awareness

quotes.quote: There is only one all pervading God. It has only one message - Love all, encompass all and transcend the limits of the selfish gene.
quotes.author: Amit Ray

quotes.quote: Common sense will nearly always stand you in better stead than a slavish adherence to the conventions.
quotes.author: M.M. Kaye,  Shadow of the Moon

quotes.quote: Sometimes, the simple things are more fun and meaningful than all the banquets in the world ...

quotes.quote: I've been the oldest child since before you were born

quotes.author: Matsuo BashÅ

quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor,  Mystery and Manners: Occasional Prose

quotes.quote: Lady Wisdom will be your close friend; and Brother Knowledge will be your pleasant companion.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: I wouldn't advise making a four-year commitment to eventually land an $8.00/hour job. Skip college. Read Wikipedia for free instead.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

quotes.quote: The dead know only one thing, it is better to be alive
quotes.author: Stanley Kubrick

quotes.quote: I am not omniscient, but I know a lot.

quotes.author: Dave Eggers,  You Shall Know Our Velocity!

quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor

quotes.quote: For we have been socialized to respect fear more than our own needs for language and definition, and while we wait in silence for that final luxury of fearlessness, the weight of that silence will choke us.
quotes.author: Audre Lorde

quotes.quote: In art, and maybe just in general, the idea is to be able to be really comfortable with contradictory ideas. In other words, wisdom might be, seem to be, two contradictory ideas both expressed at their highest level and just let to sit in the same cage sort of, vibrating. So, I think as a writer, I'm really never sure of what I really believe.
quotes.author: George Saunders

quotes.quote: All you can do is make your decisions based on what you know now.
quotes.author: Malinda Lo,  Huntress

quotes.quote: After all Death is a Symbol that there was Life.
quotes.author: Mario Benedetti

quotes.quote: What do we any of us have but our illusions? And what do we ask of others but that we be allowed to keep them?
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham

quotes.quote: The exaltation and happiness of any community, goes hand in hand with the knowledge possessed by the people, when applied to laudable ends; whereupon we can exclaim like the wise man; righteousness exalteth a nation; for righteousness embraces knowledge and knowledge is power.
quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr.

quotes.quote: It is a common sentence that knowledge is power; but who hath duly considered or set forth the power of ignorance? Knowledge slowly builds up what ignorance in an hour pulls down.
quotes.author: George Eliot,  Daniel Deronda

quotes.quote: He who dares not offend cannot be honest.
quotes.author: Thomas Paine

quotes.quote: Your decision to be, have and do something out of ordinary entails facing difficulties that are out of the ordinary as well. Sometimes your greatest asset is simply your ability to stay with it longer than anyone else.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: Ordinary people merely think how they shall 'spend' their time; a man of talent tries to 'use' it.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: If men could learn from history, what lessons it might teach us. But passion and party blind our eyes, and the light which experience gives us is a lantern on the stern, which shines only on the waves behind us.
quotes.author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

quotes.quote: Faith moves mountains, but only knowledge moves them to the right place...
quotes.author: Joseph Goebbels

quotes.quote: There is no knowing that does not begin with knowing God.
quotes.author: John Calvin

quotes.quote: To ask the 'right' question is far more important than to receive the answer. The solution of a problem lies in the understanding of the problem; the answer is not outside the problem, it is in the problem.
quotes.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti,  The Flight of the Eagle

quotes.quote: We women talk too much, but even then we don't tell half what we know.
quotes.author: Nancy Astor the Viscountess Astor

quotes.quote: Was not Hypatia the greatest philosopher of Alexandria, and a true martyr to the old values of learning? She was torn to pieces by a mob of incensed Christians not because she was a woman, but because her learning was so profound, her skills at dialectic so extensive that she reduced all who queried her to embarrassed silence. They could not argue with her, so they murdered her.
quotes.author: Iain Pears,  The Dream of Scipio

quotes.quote: We need learn what we need to learn, know what we need to know, and do what we need to do.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson

quotes.quote: To make no mistakes is not in the power of man; but from their errors and mistakes the wise and good learn wisdom for the future.
quotes.author: Plutarch

quotes.quote: The future will be what it will, and fretting about it will only make your fears more likely to come true.
quotes.author: Christopher Paolini,  Inheritance

quotes.quote: They are called, "SELF-worth"and "SELF-esteem"for a reason... we can't let others decide what we are worth, that is so dangerous! Empower yourself!
quotes.author: Jaeda DeWalt

quotes.quote: If I'd stayed there, would I always have been happy? No, I suppose not. People move away, grow older, die, and the bright belief that there will be another marvelous thing around each corner fades. It is now or never; we must snatch at happiness as it flies.
quotes.author: J.L. Carr,  A Month in the Country

quotes.quote: A visitor is a friend, he brings news, good or bad, which is bread to the hungry minds in lonely places. A real friend who comes to the house is a heavenly messenger, who brings the panis angelorum.
quotes.author: Karen Blixen,  Out of Africa

quotes.quote: TO the States or any one of them, or any city of the States, Resist much, obey little, Once unquestioning obedience, once fully enslaved,Once fully enslaved, no nation, state, city of this earth, ever after-ward resumes its liberty.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman,  Leaves of Grass

quotes.quote: Suffering teaches joy.
quotes.author: Sonia Rumzi

quotes.quote: Without feelings of respect, what is there to distinguish men from beasts?
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: When you know the knower within, you don't need to know further. When you know the meditator within, you don't need to meditate further. When you truly know the worshiper in you, you are to be worshiped.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power
